evidence.quote: Tuesday's vote by the Clearfield City Council prohibits data center development in the city in the next 180 days as city officials study whether new guidelines are warranted to govern their creation and operation. ... Tuesday's measure passed 4-0, with the four city council members present voting for it.

evidence.supports: Official signed minutes of the August 25, 2026 work session in which staff and the city attorney discussed a pending Freeport Center data-center zoning-determination request and confirmed the Council could adopt a 180-day temporary land use regulation; directs staff to bring the matter back for Council action (which occurred September 8, 2026).
evidence.quote: Councilmember Peterson asked whether the City could adopt a temporary land use regulation before the current applicant obtained an entitlement. Mr. Allen explained that the City had received only a zoning determination request, which was not an entitlement application, and confirmed that the Council could adopt a temporary land use regulation. He stated that such a regulation could remain in effect for 180 days

evidence.supports: Confirms the August 4, 2026 Commission vote approving a six-month data center moratorium, following a Planning Commission recommendation, and that the county code has no data center provisions.
evidence.quote: The Sanpete County Commission approved a six-month moratorium on new data center development Tuesday, Aug. 4, giving county officials time to draft and adopt land-use regulations for the emerging industry before any proposals can move forward.

decisions.notes: Verified against the Sanpete Messenger's Aug. 4, 2026 report: Commission approval of a six-month data-center moratorium, following a Planning Commission recommendation. The article notes this mirrors a separate June 2026 six-month moratorium on commercial solar farm development -- a distinct instrument not currently in the inventory and outside this packet's scope, so not actioned here, but worth flagging to the coordinator as a possible missing row for a future pass.
